problem_text:
A logistics company needs to schedule 9 delivery trucks to transport goods through 9 distribution centers.

Each truck must follow a specific route represented as pairs (Distribution Center, Unloading time),
where each pair specifies the distribution center where the truck must stop and the time required to unload its cargo.
The order of pairs indicates the required sequence in which the distribution centers must be visited.

Truck details:
* T1 follows the route: (D9, 8) → (D6, 5) → (D2, 4) → (D7, 9) → (D1, 10) → (D3, 4) → (D4, 2) → (D8, 8) → (D5, 4)
* T2 follows the route: (D6, 2) → (D7, 8) → (D3, 7) → (D8, 8) → (D1, 6) → (D2, 10) → (D4, 5) → (D9, 8) → (D5, 3)
* T3 follows the route: (D5, 2) → (D1, 7) → (D4, 4) → (D6, 5) → (D8, 2) → (D7, 7) → (D3, 10) → (D9, 5) → (D2, 9)
* T4 follows the route: (D1, 2) → (D9, 2) → (D4, 9) → (D6, 10) → (D7, 3) → (D3, 5) → (D8, 6) → (D5, 8) → (D2, 9)
* T5 follows the route: (D4, 6) → (D7, 3) → (D8, 2) → (D2, 9) → (D5, 6) → (D6, 10) → (D9, 4) → (D1, 2) → (D3, 9)
* T6 follows the route: (D2, 1) → (D8, 7) → (D5, 5) → (D7, 9) → (D4, 6) → (D3, 4) → (D9, 10) → (D1, 6) → (D6, 5)
* T7 follows the route: (D2, 5) → (D8, 8) → (D7, 1) → (D9, 6) → (D1, 6) → (D5, 4) → (D6, 6) → (D3, 6) → (D4, 6)
* T8 follows the route: (D7, 6) → (D4, 1) → (D1, 7) → (D8, 3) → (D5, 2) → (D3, 3) → (D2, 1) → (D9, 9) → (D6, 5)
* T9 follows the route: (D4, 5) → (D6, 1) → (D2, 2) → (D5, 8) → (D1, 5) → (D7, 7) → (D3, 4) → (D9, 3) → (D8, 8)

Each unloading operation must proceed without interruption once it begins,
and each distribution center can only accommodate one truck at a time for unloading.
The objective is to determine the processing sequence of all unloading operations at the distribution centers
so that the total completion time for all delivery trucks is minimized.
